attchmntText: Commercial Syn Bags Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Commercial Syn Bags Limited has closed its trading window for designated persons from 19th November, 2026 until 48 hours after announcing the outcome of the Board Meeting scheduled for 26th November, 2026. This closure is pursuant to the SEBI Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015. Promoters, directors, key managerial personnel, designated employees, and their immediate relatives are prohibited from dealing in the company's shares directly or indirectly during this period. The notice was issued by Company Secretary Sandeep Patel on 18th November, 2026.

attchmntText: Commercial Syn Bags Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Commercial Syn Bags Limited submitted press clippings regarding the extract of standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during a meeting held on 14th November 2026 at 5:00 P.M. at the registered office. The company published the advertisement in the Free Press journal in English and Chotha Sansar in Hindi on 15th November 2026. This filing is made pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III Part A(A) and Regulation 47(1) of the SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. The submission was made to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. Sandeep Patel, Company Secretary, signed the letter on 15th November 2026.

attchmntText: Commercial Syn Bags Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Commercial Syn Bags Limited filed a statement regarding deviations in the utilization of funds from its preferential issue for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company reports no deviation or variation in the use of funds raised. The preferential issue was conducted on 17th September 2026, raising Rs. 871.02 Lakhs. The statement was reviewed by the Audit Committee and taken on record by the Board on 14th November 2026. The original allocation of funds was Rs. 1440.00 Lakhs, with Rs. 1155.85 Lakhs utilized. Funds were allocated for the purchase of property, plant, and equipment, long-term and short-term working capital requirements, and general corporate purposes. The monitoring agency is not applicable.

attchmntText: Commercial Syn Bags Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Commercial Syn Bags Limited submitted standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 14th November 2026. The Audit Committee also approved the financials. The independent auditor issued a review report with no modifications or qualifications. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 23092.25 lakhs. Profit before tax was 2022.34 lakhs. Profit for the period was 1743.85 lakhs. Earnings per share was 4.32. Total assets stood at 37517.21 lakhs. The company is filing the results in XBRL format. The results will be published in newspapers.
